thresholds_and_controls.policy: Thresholds are frozen before real execution. Unless a field says max/atol, every *_min or *_strict_gt threshold uses strict > comparison; max/atol fields use <=. Report point estimate, units, aggregation unit, 95% CI, null distribution, comparator, and pass/fail for every control. Any unjustifiable zero-effect gate is blocked rather than accepted.

provenance.cleanup: CUDA synchronized; model gradients cleared; CUDA cache emptied

feature_matrix.config: binary token presence; attention_mask; no padding; target IDs excluded

adapter_applicability.forbidden_substitute: Do not create a fake ModelAdapter or claim adapter applicability for GPT-2.

model.license_access: MIT; public Hugging Face access; record model-card/license response and cache manifest at run time
model.package_constraints: transformers>=4.45,<5.0; tokenizers>=0.20,<1.0; torch>=2.5,<3.0; install with uv --extra transformers

provenance.cleanup: CUDA synchronized; model gradients cleared; CUDA cache emptied

feature_matrix.config: binary token presence; attention_mask; no padding; target IDs excluded

records.capability: Direct logit lens plus separately calibrated affine tuned lens
Factor separation and held-out disentanglement controls
Selective additive hidden-state steering with causal controls

tokenization.determinism: Set Python, NumPy, and Torch seeds; record deterministic-algorithm setting, CUDA device, and tool versions.
tokenization.direction_fit: Train groups only; normalize direction on the train partition; no holdout fitting or threshold tuning.
tokenization.layer_indexing_rule: Transformer block h.L intervention maps to native output_hidden_states index L+1; record both indices.
tokenization.target_position: last non-padding prompt token; target_text is scored as the next-token class

target_token_offline_contract.check: Pinned GPT2TokenizerFast must tokenize each target_text to exactly one token with no added special token; fail closed otherwise.

tokenization.target_token_requirement: Resolve target_text to exactly one GPT-2 token and record token id/string; abort as failed if this invariant is false. The expected one-token property of ` true` and ` false` is only an offline contract check, not a pre-run fact or evidence claim.
tokenization.tokenizer: GPT2TokenizerFast from the pinned model revision
